properties.name: unified-storage.chunk-size
properties.description: Global chunk size for cross-provider streaming pipe and multipart uploads. Default: 64 MB. Can be overridden per mount via partSize.

properties.name: unified-storage.mounts
properties.description: Logical mount points map. Key = logical mount name (e.g. reports, archives, temp). Value = mount configuration (provider-specific subclass at runtime).

properties.name: unified-storage.posix.enabled
properties.description:
Enable or disable POSIX metadata persistence. true (default) — permissions, owner, group and timestamps are stored in the storage_posix_metadata table after each write. false — all POSIX operations are no-ops; no database required. Example: 
 unified-storage: posix: enabled: false
